title: Standardize interaction outline scaling across density and responsive breakpoints
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Multiple interactive components (buttons, icon buttons, table rows, dropdowns, chart legend pills) render inconsistent focus outlines across density modes (compact/dense/comfortable) and at different viewport breakpoints. This inconsistency causes keyboard users to lose the focus target visually at narrow widths and creates borderline contrast failures in high-contrast themes. It also increases VPAT risk because focus indicators are sometimes omitted for icon-only controls and virtualized rows.

Goal: Define a single, token-driven outline/affordance system that scales for density and breakpoint, preserves accessible contrast ratios, covers touch vs non-touch heuristics, and provides a migration plan for component library and product surfaces. Deliverables include token spec, component updates, engineering PRs, QA checklist, and VPAT evidence updates.
out_of_scope: Global theming refactor (separate EPIC), changing baseline spacing tokens, or reworking keyboard focus behaviour for custom canvas widgets (tracked elsewhere).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Core token set (focus-width, focus-offset, focus-color, focus-radius) defined and documented for compact/dense/comfortable and narrow/wide breakpoints. 2) Buttons and IconButtons show a visible focus ring for keyboard-only and programmatic focus; icon-only controls include an accessible target area. 3) Table rows and virtualized lists show a persistent outline that does not clip at container boundaries and meets WCAG contrast for 3:1 at minimum for focus indicator against adjacent UI. 4) Chart legend pills and inline action pills have an explicit focus outline variant in the tokens; visual diffs approved. 5) QA checklist and automated screenshot tests added; VPAT evidence updated with examples and remediation notes.
technical_notes:
- Use CSS custom properties and component-level token fallbacks to avoid runtime rehydration flashes.
- Use outline-offset for 1px outlines in dense mode to preserve hit area.
- Provide forced-visible focus utility (.focus-visible-force) for visual regression tests.
- Include high-contrast media query variants and an API to opt into stronger outlines for admin/assistive mode.
migration_plan: Phase 1: Tokens merged and small components (Button, IconButton) updated with feature flag. Phase 2: Table/VirtualList changes with focused-row test harness and regression snapshots. Phase 3: Chart legend and inline components updated; rollout to beta customers; VPAT evidence collected. Estimated total: 3 sprints.
qa_steps: Keyboard test: Tab, Shift+Tab through toolbar with compact and comfortable densities at 320px and 1280px widths
Virtualized list: Use keyboard to page and ensure row focus indicator remains visible when container scrolls
Icon-only controls: Confirm 44x44 target area and visible outline on focus-visible
High-contrast theme: Toggle and confirm outline contrast ratios meet thresholds
Automated visual diffs: Add Percy snapshots for each component state and density
acceptance_tests: Percy: baseline vs new focus tokens show no regressions outside focus variants
E2E: Cypress keyboard traversal test passes for toolbar and table keyboard flows
Unit: token rendering snapshot for compact/dense/comfortable exists
comments: 2025-02-18 - Asha Patel: Initial triage — multiple design reviews flagged inconsistent focus rings during the a11y sweep. Filed ticket to consolidate tokens and produce a migration path. Prioritized because this impacts VPAT readiness for upcoming audit.

2025-02-20 - Jordan Kim: Did a quick audit across idx pages; observed focus clipping on virtualized table at 320px; icon-only controls in toolbar lacked visible target. Attached screen captures in Figma file.

2025-02-24 - Miguel Torres (Engineering): Estimated 3 points. Biggest risk is virtualized list reflow causing clipped outlines; propose adding outline-offset and a focus-viewport shim in VirtualList component. Will prototype in ENG branch.

2025-02-27 - Design review: Explored two options — 1px dense / 2px comfortable, and a single 2px with outline-offset. Team prefers tokenized approach to allow per-component overrides. Figma mocks uploaded.
2025-03-01 - Accessibility review (Sara Lewis): Recommend separate high-contrast token set and explicit examples for VoiceOver and NVDA. Note: include keyboard-only screenshots for VPAT examples.

2025-03-03 - Jordan Kim: WIP PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/4821. Implemented tokens + Button/IconButton updates behind feature flag. Need review from Eng and Accessibility before merging to main.
2025-03-04 - QA (Priya Nair): Started automated Percy runs. Found an edge case in chart legend where outline overlaps drop shadow — flagged for design tweak (reduce radius on pill).
next_steps: 1) Merge token spec doc to design system handbook. 2) Complete ENG PR review and add virtualized-row shim. 3) Run full Percy suite and generate VPAT visual evidence. 4) Schedule follow-up for product rollouts and notify beta customers.
